about: Kamloops sits at the confluence of the North and South Thompson rivers in B.C.’s dry Interior. It is a transportation, health, and tournament-sport hub for a large ranching and forest hinterland, with sage-covered hills and a long, ice-free riverfront. Thompson Rivers University occupies a hillside above the South Thompson. About 98,000 people live in Kamloops.
